subject.title: refactor(channels): migrate googlechat, imessage, and whatsapp group policy onto the scope tree

question: Should ScopeTree become a public Plugin SDK contract through staged channel batches, or should it remain internal until every bundled group-policy caller can migrate in one landing unit?
rationale: Both approaches are technically possible, but choosing a permanent third-party API and compatibility strategy requires maintainer intent; green parity tests do not settle that contract decision.

options.title: Consolidate the migration
options.body: Keep the new resolver internal or stack-local until all bundled callers migrate, then publish the final documented API and retire the superseded path together.

options.title: Approve staged public API
options.body: Explicitly accept the temporary parallel API, document its stability and migration plan, and add compatibility coverage showing old and new paths remain equivalent throughout the staged rollout.

recommendation.title: Consolidate the migration
recommendation.body: Keep the new resolver internal or stack-local until all bundled callers migrate, then publish the final documented API and retire the superseded path together.

likelyOwner.reason: Owns both the foundational API proposal and this first migration batch, making this person the clearest available owner for the intended staging strategy.
